children: TOKYO (dpa-AFX) - Oracle Corporation Japan (OCJ.F) revealed a profit for its first quarter that Increased, from the same period last year
The company's earnings totaled JPY18.245 billion, or JPY142 per share.  This compares with JPY14.805 billion, or JPY115 per share, last year.
The company's revenue for the period rose 13.0% to JPY74.861 billion from JPY66.275 billion last year.
Oracle Corporation Japan earnings at a glance (GAAP) :
-Earnings: JPY18.245 Bln. vs. JPY14.805 Bln. last year.
-Revenue: JPY74.861 Bln vs. JPY66.275 Bln last year.
Full year EPS guidance: JPY 525.00 To JPY 540.00
